gist: Sensei promised to come to Yuuka's 16:00 funding hearing to back the robotics club's request; he never showed, she presented alone, and later he said she did fine without him.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:30] Sensei, today at 16:00: the robotics club's funding hearing. You said you'd come and speak for the club's results.
[user:sensei 07:41] I'll be there. They deserve it. I'll even bring the competition ribbon photos.
[you 07:42] Bring the photos printed, please. The committee doesn't read phones.
[user:sensei 07:43] Printed. Got it. 16:00, committee room.
### chat:huddle:v7c1m9xe2d
# {DAY}
[noa-ushio 09:10] [face=content] The robotics club left the revised cost table on your desk. They added a spare servo line.
[you 09:11] I saw. It's a fair line. I'll defend the servos, not the second soldering iron.
[momoi-saiba 09:12] [face=surprised] Nobody told me about a second soldering iron!
[you 09:12] Because you would have bought it.
[momoi-saiba] [face=pouting] That's slander and also true.
[noa-ushio 09:14] [face=content] Sensei confirmed the photos by message last night, by the way. Printed, he said.
[you 09:15] Good. Then the table is covered on that side.
[noa-ushio 12:30] Lunch. You've reread the budget summary four times.
[you 12:31] Five. The result column is weak without outside testimony, so Sensei's part matters. His word carries with the committee.
[noa-ushio] He said he'd come. That's enough.
[you 12:32] It had better be.
[noa-ushio 15:50] The committee is seating. Chairs are set for you and one guest.
[you 15:51] Keep the guest's chair. He's on his way.
[you 15:58] *checks the door*
[noa-ushio 16:00] [face=worried] They are starting. Do you want a minute?
[you 16:01] No. We start. The club's numbers can stand on their own.
[you 16:42] *closes the binder* Servo line approved. Soldering iron cut. Total granted is eighty percent of the ask.
[noa-ushio] [face=content] That is a good result without testimony.
[you 16:43] It would have been a better one with. The chair stayed empty the whole hour.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 17:05] The hearing ended at 16:42. You weren't there.
[user:sensei 17:40] Ah, I got pulled into a long meeting at Schale and couldn't slip out. Sorry about that. Did it go okay?
[you 17:41] Eighty percent of the ask. You'd said you would speak for them.
[user:sensei 17:43] Eighty is great! You did fine without me, honestly, you always do.
[you 17:44] The photos you were bringing were meant to be on the table. I had to describe the ribbons from memory.
[user:sensei 17:46] I'm sure you described them perfectly. I'll catch the next one.
[you 17:47] There is no next one for this club this term. Good night, Sensei.
